# Rasgoal

> Zambian exam practice platform for Grade 7 and Grade 12 students, with timed mock tests, instant scoring, and progress tracking across every examinable subject.

Rasgoal is operated by Kora Technical Solutions (PACRA BN 320261068317) and serves students preparing for ECZ Grade 7 and Grade 12 examinations. It offers a free tier and paid subscriptions (K50/month or K400/year per student).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Rasgoal and entry point to sign in or sign up.
- [Sign in / Sign up](/auth): Create a Rasgoal account or log in to access practice tests.
- [Terms & Merchant Policy](/terms): Products, refund, and cancellation policy.

## Optional

- [Unsubscribe](/unsubscribe): Email unsubscribe page.
